reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Oklahoma, focus year 2021)
    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
*/

% -------------------------
% Basic utilities (no modules)
% -------------------------

less_than(A, B) :- number(A), number(B), A < B.

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
% -------------------------

jurisdiction_state(oklahoma).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(tenant1).
landlord(landlord1).
voucher(voucher1).

% The eviction action exists.
eviction_action(case1, landlord1, tenant1).

% The tenant wants to raise a defense: landlord refused a voucher.
tenant_attempts_defense(case1, voucher_refusal).

% The underlying alleged conduct: landlord refused the tenant's voucher.
landlord_refused_voucher(landlord1, tenant1, voucher1).

/* Scenario summary predicate: succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction_state(oklahoma),
    focus_year(2021),
    eviction_action(case1, landlord1, tenant1),
    tenant_attempts_defense(case1, voucher_refusal),
    landlord_refused_voucher(landlord1, tenant1, voucher1).

% -------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic, with citations)
% -------------------------

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-121(E) (2021)
  Tenant rights under 41-121 do not arise until written notice is given;
  and no rights arise if condition was caused by tenant (or related persons/animals).
*/
statute_ok_41_121_notice_prerequisite(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    tenant_written_notice_given(Tenant, Landlord),
    \+ condition_caused_by_tenant_side(Tenant, Landlord).

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-121(A) (2021)
  Material noncompliance by landlord with rental agreement or Section 18 that materially affects health or safety:
  tenant may deliver written notice; agreement terminates not less than 30 days after receipt if not remedied within 14 days.
*/
statute_ok_41_121a_right_to_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    statute_ok_41_121_notice_prerequisite(Tenant, Landlord),
    landlord_material_noncompliance(Landlord, Tenant),
    noncompliance_materially_affects(health_or_safety),
    notice_specified_breach_and_termination_date(Tenant, Landlord),
    termination_date_at_least_30_days_after_receipt(Tenant, Landlord),
    \+ landlord_adequately_remedied_within_14_days(Landlord, Tenant).

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-121(B) (2021)
  Material noncompliance materially affecting health; remediable by repairs with reasonable cost < $100:
  tenant may notify in writing intent to correct at landlord's expense after 14 days; if landlord fails, tenant may repair and deduct.
*/
statute_ok_41_121b_right_repair_and_deduct_under_100(Tenant, Landlord, Cost) :-
    statute_ok_41_121_notice_prerequisite(Tenant, Landlord),
    landlord_material_noncompliance(Landlord, Tenant),
    noncompliance_materially_affects(health),
    breach_remediable_by_repairs(Cost),
    less_than(Cost, 100),
    tenant_notice_intent_repair_after_14_days(Tenant, Landlord),
    \+ landlord_complied_within_14_days_or_emergency_prompt(Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_caused_work_done_workmanlike(Tenant),
    tenant_submitted_itemized_statement(Tenant, Landlord).

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-121(C) (2021)
  Landlord willfully or negligently fails to supply essential service (heat/water/etc):
  tenant may give written notice and may terminate immediately, procure services and deduct, recover damages, or procure substitute housing.
*/
statute_ok_41_121c_rights_for_essential_service_failure(Tenant, Landlord, Remedy) :-
    statute_ok_41_121_notice_prerequisite(Tenant, Landlord),
    landlord_failed_to_supply_essential_service(Landlord, Tenant),
    failure_willful_or_negligent(Landlord),
    tenant_written_notice_specifying_breach(Tenant, Landlord),
    statute_ok_41_121c_remedy(Remedy).

statute_ok_41_121c_remedy(immediate_termination).
statute_ok_41_121c_remedy(procure_and_deduct).
statute_ok_41_121c_remedy(recover_diminution_damages).
statute_ok_41_121c_remedy(substitute_housing_rent_excused).

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-121(D) (2021)
  Noncompliance renders unit uninhabitable or poses imminent threat; not remedied as promptly as conditions require:
  tenant may immediately terminate upon written notice specifying the noncompliance.
*/
statute_ok_41_121d_right_immediate_termination_uninhabitable(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    statute_ok_41_121_notice_prerequisite(Tenant, Landlord),
    landlord_noncompliance_renders_uninhabitable_or_imminent_threat(Landlord, Tenant),
    \+ remedied_as_promptly_as_conditions_require(Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_written_notice_specifying_noncompliance(Tenant, Landlord).

/*
  41 OK Stat  41-123 (2021)
  If landlord wrongfully removes or excludes tenant from possession:
  tenant may recover possession or terminate, and recover up to twice avg monthly rent or twice actual damages, etc.
*/
statute_ok_41_123_remedy_for_wrongful_removal_or_exclusion(Tenant, Landlord, Remedy) :-
    landlord_wrongfully_removed_or_excluded(Landlord, Tenant),
    statute_ok_41_123_remedy(Remedy).

statute_ok_41_123_remedy(recover_possession).
statute_ok_41_123_remedy(terminate_and_recover_damages).

% -------------------------
% Statute-to-eviction "defense availability" mapping (derived, not hardcoded answer)
% -------------------------

/* A tenant has a statutory ground (that could function as a rebuttal/defense) only if one
   of the provided statutes supplies a relevant tenant right/remedy on these facts. */
statutory_defense_available_in_eviction(Case, habitability_or_health_safety_noncompliance) :-
    eviction_action(Case, Landlord, Tenant),
    (   statute_ok_41_121a_right_to_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Landlord)
    ;   statute_ok_41_121b_right_repair_and_deduct_under_100(Tenant, Landlord, _Cost)
    ;   statute_ok_41_121d_right_immediate_termination_uninhabitable(Tenant, Landlord)
    ),
    !.

statutory_defense_available_in_eviction(Case, essential_service_failure) :-
    eviction_action(Case, Landlord, Tenant),
    statute_ok_41_121c_rights_for_essential_service_failure(Tenant, Landlord, _Remedy),
    !.

statutory_defense_available_in_eviction(Case, wrongful_removal_or_exclusion) :-
    eviction_action(Case, Landlord, Tenant),
    statute_ok_41_123_remedy_for_wrongful_removal_or_exclusion(Tenant, Landlord, _Remedy),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Facts that would be needed to trigger statutes (NOT present in this scenario)
% -------------------------
% These are intentionally absent for this question; they are listed here only to make
% the program complete and to avoid undefined predicates.

tenant_written_notice_given(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.
condition_caused_by_tenant_side(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.

landlord_material_noncompliance(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.
noncompliance_materially_affects(_What) :- fail.
notice_specified_breach_and_termination_date(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.
termination_date_at_least_30_days_after_receipt(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.
landlord_adequately_remedied_within_14_days(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.

breach_remediable_by_repairs(_Cost) :- fail.
tenant_notice_intent_repair_after_14_days(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.
landlord_complied_within_14_days_or_emergency_prompt(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.
tenant_caused_work_done_workmanlike(_Tenant) :- fail.
tenant_submitted_itemized_statement(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.

landlord_failed_to_supply_essential_service(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.
failure_willful_or_negligent(_Landlord) :- fail.
tenant_written_notice_specifying_breach(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.

landlord_noncompliance_renders_uninhabitable_or_imminent_threat(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.
remedied_as_promptly_as_conditions_require(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.
tenant_written_notice_specifying_noncompliance(_Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.

landlord_wrongfully_removed_or_excluded(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.

% -------------------------
% Question answering
% -------------------------

/* The defense "landlord refused a voucher" is permitted only if some provided statute
   makes voucher refusal an available eviction defense on these facts. Under the given statutes,
   voucher refusal is not a listed trigger; thus only succeeds if statutes independently provide it. */
tenant_can_raise_attempted_defense(Case) :-
    tenant_attempts_defense(Case, Defense),
    defense_supported_by_provided_statutes(Case, Defense),
    !.

defense_supported_by_provided_statutes(Case, voucher_refusal) :-
    % If voucher refusal were covered, we'd derive it from statute predicates.
    % Under the supplied statutes (41-121, 41-123), there is no rule turning voucher refusal
    % into a tenant remedy/defense in an eviction action.
    statutory_defense_available_in_eviction(Case, voucher_refusal),
    !.

defense_supported_by_provided_statutes(Case, OtherDefense) :-
    % Generic path: defenses that correspond to an actual statutory ground are supported.
    statutory_defense_available_in_eviction(Case, OtherDefense),
    !.

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_can_raise_attempted_defense(case1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
